name: Freemason
choreography: Compact hip load, first-active horizontal hammer strike, weighted brake, rising cross-body strike at the 45% beat, descending blow at the 78% beat, final horizontal hammer carry on release, return to the approved Shoulder Drive guard.
requirements: Hold compact load until first active
Distinct strikes at saved intermediate impact ticks 40 and 70
Final strike begins at actual release tick 90
Constant anatomical scale; both hands grip the same hammer
Block and whiff use the opening strike's withdrawal
Native hit, block, whiff and mirrored review
